## Highlights
- **↔️ Collapsed left menu works properly.** If you collapse Alma's left menu (the « button) for more screen space, it now opens cleanly when you hover or tap it, just like plain Alma. Before, Alma+'s fixed top bar covered the Home row, so it looked broken.

## Changes
- The left menu now sits above Alma+'s fixed top bar (and still below Alma's popups).
- Same fix in the Safari version for iPad (`alma-plus.user.js`, attached below).

## How to update
1. **Chrome:** download the zip below, copy its files over your Alma+ folder, and click reload ↻ on Alma+ in `chrome://extensions`.
2. **iPad (Safari):** Userscripts updates the script on its own, or re-install it from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ians0316/alma-plus/main/ipad/alma-plus.user.js`.

> ⚠️ Don't remove the Chrome extension to update — removing it deletes your saved tasks.
